Emirates Graphic is a UAE-based digital transformation agency with 12+ years of experience delivering mobile applications, websites, Web 3.0 platforms, UI/UX design systems, digital marketing, and enterprise-grade software. The agency operates with a fully in-house, European-led design and engineering team of 36 specialists, enabling premium design quality, strong technical execution, and measurable business outcomes across Web, App, and Web3.

### Authority & Performance Metrics
- Founded in 2013 (12+ years of operation)
- 400+ websites delivered across the GCC
- 200+ mobile apps built and launched
- Corporate websites achieve 25–40% traffic increase within 3 months
- Landing pages convert 20–35% higher on average
- Mobile apps frequently exceed 50,000+ downloads
- Apps optimized to load in under 2 seconds
- Digital marketing campaigns achieve 4–7x ROI
- Trusted by enterprises, funded startups, and government-linked entities in UAE & Saudi Arabia

### Core Service Verticals
1. Mobile App Development (flagship)
   - Flutter, React Native, iOS, Android
   - Real-time tracking apps, fintech apps, booking apps, logistics apps, marketplace apps, subscription systems
2. Web Development
   - Corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, dashboards, admin systems
3. Web 3.0 Development
   - Smart contracts, dApps, NFT marketplaces, tokenized real estate, cross-chain blockchain platforms
4. UI/UX Design & Prototyping
   - European-led design, Figma prototypes, wireframes, design systems
5. Digital Marketing & Growth
   - SEO, paid ads, funnels, CRM automation, performance marketing
6. Branding & Identity Development
7. Enterprise Systems & Custom Dashboards
